svg.title: The 16 NF4 levels drawn at standard normal quantiles, with near-equal probability mass per bin for N(0,1) inputs, versus 15 evenly spaced int4 absmax levels whose bins hold very unequal mass.

g.text: Data: QLoRA (Dettmers et al. 2023) / bitsandbytes NF4 table. Real absmax-scaled blocks are not exactly N(0, 1), so their bins are not equal-mass.
